label: sec:q-opers-intro
html: This section turns to the spectral side of the conjecture and the canonical objects that realise it. It returns to the q-oper: a \check{G}_q-bundle on X, equipped with a reduction to the Borel subgroup and a q-flat connection in oper position. This object provides the rigid spectral data dual to the automorphic q-Hecke eigensheaves. The fibre functor maps every q-oper to a q-Hecke eigensheaf, with the eigenvalue determined by the oper coordinates, realising the abstract Tannakian mediation. Whereas the (G, q)-opers of Edward Frenkel and Nicolai Reshetikhin [frenkel-reshetikhin1998], Mina Aganagic, Edward Frenkel, and Andrei Okounkov [aganagic2018], and Peter Koroteev and Anton M. Zeitlin [koroteev-zeitlin2022] are meromorphic q-difference connections with respect to a multiplicative shift z \mapsto qz on \mathbb{P}^1 or \mathbb{C}^\times, the q-opers considered here replace that multiplicative shift by the contact-deformed differential d_q so that the Borel transversality condition remains defined on a compact curve X of genus g \ge 2.
